title: Colors
wikitext:
The palette available in QuakeWorld when setting your skin color with the [http://ezquake.sourceforge.net/docs/?commands#color color] command is as in the image below. For blue skins you would set "color 13". These colors are also used for color forcing commands like [http://ezquake.sourceforge.net/docs/?commands#teamcolor teamcolor] and [http://ezquake.sourceforge.net/docs/?commands#enemycolor enemycolor].
